issue.title: Autopilot Server Example segfaults
issue.body:
Hi,

i am trying to learn with the MavSDK to implement Mavlink for a custom drone and wanted to run and understand the `autopilot_server` example.

No matter which release (tested: 1.4.3, 1.0.0 and 0.44.0) on different Platforms (Rasberry Pi OS, Ubuntu Baremetal, official Docker-Images, WSL2 etc.), the example always segfaults.

I precompile the MAVSDK via:

```
cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -Bbuild/default -H.
cmake --build build/default -j8
sudo cmake --build build/default --target install
```

which works flawlessly.

then, i build the example:

```
cd examples/autopilot_server
cmake -Bbuild -H.
cmake --build build -j4
```

Then i can run it via:

```
sudo build/autopilot_server
```

comments.body: That doesn't look so good. Thanks for the detailed bug report. I'll try to have a closer look.

> only the current master shows a somewhat different behaviour, as it doesn't segfault, but the vehicle never takes off.

Ah, so that means I probably fixed the segfault recently in https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/pull/1733/commits/0240c2de4fc80c141ccf1cddb2462f2ce169de9b.

What's the output when it never takes off? Maybe something like "manual control lost"? In that case try this:

```
param->set_param_int("COM_RCL_EXCEPT", 7)
```
